title: South Coast Outward Bound Leadership Camp
body:
Applications are NOW OPEN

We are excited to offer Year 8 students the opportunity to apply for the Outward Bound South Coast Leadership Program September 7-11 2026 a unique five-day leadership experience designed to develop confidence, resilience, teamwork and leadership skills through adventure-based learning.

The program empowers young people to step into their leadership potential through activities such as high ropes, hiking and navigation, leadership initiatives, camping, and values-based challenges, all facilitated by experienced Outward-Bound staff.

Thanks to generous funding, only 18 fully funded places are available. Successful applicants will only be required to contribute $95 towards the cost of travel to the program.

To be considered, students must complete the Leadership Program Application Questionnaire, which is available:
on Student Notices, and
in their school email.
The link below is accessible using your School email (@education.nsw.gov.au)
Outward Bound Opportunity 2026 Year 8 - Fill out form
CLOSING DATE 14/8/26 3PM
Applications will be reviewed by a selection panel, and students will be notified of the outcome following the review process.

This is an outstanding opportunity for students to challenge themselves, develop lifelong leadership skills, and represent Ulladulla High School. We encourage all interested Year 8 students to submit an application.
If you have any questions, please contact your Year advisors, Ms Bunyan or Ms Waser

title: Youth Advisory Committee
body:
Youth Advisory Committee: Tuesday 18th Session 3 & 4 in the Library Lower Level

The purpose of this project is to work alongside young people to develop a program that works FOR young people to be empowered and have your say on Council decisions that effect you, or on topic you feel passionately about.
In the session we will be exploring what's important to young people, what supports empowerment, what barriers exist, and what ideas you have for the future. There are no right or wrong answers, and we're really interested in hearing your perspectives.

A council member will be there to listen, learn, and capture your ideas about:
What helps young people feel empowered and connected.
What challenges or barriers young people are facing.
What opportunities currently exist and what's missing.
Ideas for future programs, services, initiatives, or supports.
How young people would like to be involved in shaping decisions and creating change.
Your input will directly contribute to the ongoing development of this project.

title: SOUTH COAST CHANGEMAKERS FORUM 3 day camp
body:
When 27th - 29th November, 2026

Where Waterslea Conference Centre

Application form: https://www.sonderyouth.com/south-coast-changemakers-forum

The South Coast Changemakers Forum is a 3 day camp for young people aged 14 - 17 to connect, learn and design their own projects for positive change for the South Coast.
The Forum provides young people with the opportunity to connect, develop skills and positive change networks in the community.

As part of the Forum, participants take part in the Over 3 days they design and pitch projects for positive change. Participants are then given the opportunity to go on to complete their ideas in the Changemakers Program.

title: Community Connect Expo
body:
Community Connect Expo at the Dunn-Lewis Centre! Thursday 10th September

We need volunteers to help run stalls, welcome guests, and help run activities and events on the day. If you're interested please pop your name under this post or let Ms Visser know ASAP.

This event is a chance for all students to explore, learn, and connect with their local community. There will be over 100 stalls and various activities and events taking place.

The organisers- Community Connect Southern Shoalhaven (CCSS)

GENERAL INFO

The main goal is to showcase the fantastic community organisations that make our area special. It is a giant 'Thank You' celebration for our local volunteers!

Locals and visitors can be informed of all that volunteers do for our community.

Groups will come together to connect in a positive way. We encourage the sharing of ideas with other groups and volunteers so as to collaborate in future.

We had some great outcomes last year with groups recruiting new members, sharing and starting some projects together. This year will be even better!

The Expo Event is organised by Community Connect South Shoalhaven which is auspice by Business Milton Ulladulla.

title: STUDENT VOLUNTEERS NEEDED
body:
STUDENT VOLUNTEERS NEEDED. Hi everyone, here is a message from Mr Pearson. Please read, and if you can help out for this event, can you post your name in the comments asap. Thank you :)

***On Friday there is a football game on the bottom oval starting 10am. Can we please have ten students from leadership team in full uniform to help on the day? They would need to be available 9:00am to around 11:30am.

Five students at MPC street entry. Five students at bottom oval gate near cricket nets.

MPC entry
Meet visiting team and show them to MPC changerooms. Mr Richardson will also be meeting visiting school to welcome them. QR code for teacher/coach and parents to sign into the school. Show parent/carers location of toilets. If during game facilities need to be used, leadership team walk visitors to and from toilets.

Bottom oval entry
Meet UHS parent/carers. QR code for visitors to register. Inform parents location of toilets. If during game facilities need to be used, leadership team walk visitors to and from toilets. Show parent/carers to spectator area. They have been asked to bring folding chairs to sit on. Will be invited to sit on the Northwestern side of the oval.

Leadership team meet at student services Thursday afternoon session 5 for briefing about QR Codes, uniform, roles and responsibility.
